title: fxv user list command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv user list` command's JSON output.

users.description: The users in the repository's user database, ordered by username then id, after the requested filters.

id.description: The user's numeric ID. Stable for the user's whole life, unlike 'username', which a rename changes, and the only thing that distinguishes two deactivated users who had the same username.

email.description: The user's email address. Absent when the user has none.

deactivated.description: Whether the user has been deactivated, hiding them from default listings and preventing them from logging in.

current.description: Whether this workspace is logged in as this user. False for every user when nobody is logged in, or when the login no longer refers to an active user.
